subject: MSA clause review + narrow window for vendor onboarding checks
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@solstice.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@solstice.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, May 30, 2027 at 09:02 AM -0700
Subject: MSA clause review + narrow window for vendor onboarding checks

Hi Laura / Procurement team —

Thanks again for moving quickly on the MSA. Legal at Solstice highlighted three specific clauses (data retention, subprocessing, and audit log access) they'd like to walk through with our GC before we sign. We can do a focused redline call + vendor onboarding checklist review in the same meeting to keep this compact.

Proposed 45-minute slots (Pacific):
- Tue 6/1, 11:00–11:45am
- Wed 6/2, 9:30–10:15am
- Wed 6/2, 4:00–4:45pm

I attached the latest redlines (MSA_redlines_v3.pdf) and our vendor-onboard checklist (vendor-onboard-checklist.xlsx) so your legal and procurement folks can prep. Can you confirm who from your side will join (specifically the GC/contact who owns redlines)?

Goal for call: agree on clause language or capture final action items and timeline to close. If you prefer two separate shorter calls (legal first, onboarding second) say so and we’ll adjust.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment: MSA_redlines_v3.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
Attachment: vendor-onboard-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@solstice.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@solstice.ai>, Gina Morales <gina.morales@solstice.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, May 30, 2027 at 10:15 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA clause review + narrow window for vendor onboarding checks

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the materials; I shared them with Gina (our GC) and she asked to be on the redline call. We prefer to keep the legal redline discussion separate from the onboarding checklist (so we can loop in infra owners for the checklist). That said, we can do two back-to-back 30-minute slots on the same day.

Gina and I are available:
- Wed 6/2, 9:30–10:00am (legal redline)
- Wed 6/2, 10:15–10:45am (onboarding checklist with infra)

If that works, can you make space for Ben (technical buyer) and Kim (onboarding lead) for the 10:15 slot? Also, can you share any short notes on the three clauses Gina mentioned so her team can triage before the call?

Laura
Laura Chen
Head of Procurement | Solstice AI
laura.chen@solstice.ai

Laura / Gina —

Thanks — Wed 6/2 back-to-back slots noted. We’ll book the 9:30–10:00am legal redline and the 10:15–10:45am onboarding checklist. Calendar invites to follow.

Quick context on the three clauses Gina raised (short bullets you can share with legal):
- Data retention: We retain logs for 90 days by default; we can offer a 365-day retention addendum for enterprise customers with appropriate controls and pricing.
- Subprocessing: We list subcontractors in the appendix; customers get notification of new subprocessors and an escalation path for restrictions.
- Audit logs / access: We provide access to audit logs via signed request and can provide scoped extracts for compliance reviews; full system access is not provided for security reasons.

Ben, Kim — please be on both invites; Ben to cover the subprocessor appendix and Kim to cover onboarding checklist/SSO and evidence items.

Marissa
Marissa Cole

marissa_cole@redwood.com

All —

Confirmed on our end. I accepted both invites. A few operational notes I’ll bring to the onboarding checklist call:
- Evidence bundle we’ll aim to surface during the 10:15 call: SOC 2 scope, retention policy excerpt, and sample audit log extract (redacted).
- If legal wants a deeper dive on subprocessor control, we can follow up with a short tech session; would prefer to capture open items in the redline call and avoid blocking signature on minor clarifications.

Kim — I attached a lightweight deck (vendor-onboarding-onepager.pdf) for the checklist call and added a Confluence link with the evidence runbook.

Ben Carter
